name: Timbermaw Post
summary: Timbermaw Post is a small furbolg camp situated in the snowy expanse of Winterspring, nestled between Frostfire Hot Springs and Lake Kel'Theril. Despite bearing the name of the uncorrupted Timbermaw tribe, the encampment has fallen under the aggressive grip of the corrupted Winterfall furbolgs.

sections.title: A Displaced Outpost
sections.body: Positioned just southeast across the road from Frostfire Hot Springs and west of the frozen Lake Kel'Theril, Timbermaw Post stands as a bitter reminder of the furbolgs' internal strife in Winterspring. Despite its Timbermaw name, travelers approaching the camp will find no friendly welcomes. The outpost is controlled by the hostile Winterfall tribe, driven mad and violent by demonic corruption. Now crowded with savage Winterfall furbolgs, the camp serves as an aggressive staging ground encroaching upon the central road.

faq.q: Why is it called Timbermaw Post if Winterfall furbolgs live here?
faq.answer: Despite its name, the camp is controlled by the corrupted Winterfall tribe. Its founding history is not known.
It lies in central Winterspring, situated southeast across the main road from Frostfire Hot Springs and directly west of Lake Kel'Theril.

faq.q: Are the furbolgs at Timbermaw Post hostile?
aliases: can i talk to timbermaw post
faq.answer: Yes. Even if you have earned peaceful standing with the actual Timbermaw tribe, the furbolgs inhabiting this post belong to the hostile Winterfall tribe and will attack intruders on sight.

angles.text: For druids who revere the furbolgs as ancient stewards of nature, witnessing the camp occupied by madness-driven Winterfall furbolgs is a stark display of the Burning Legion's lingering taint.
